product: Write data back to Databricks from Google Sheets
tagline: The Databricks Connector for Google Sheets now lets you write data from Google Sheets back to a Unity Catalog table.
what_it_does: The Databricks Connector for Google Sheets now lets you write data from Google Sheets back to a Unity Catalog table.
